record.paper_title: Research Problems in Function Theory (New Edition)
record.original_question: A function f (z) = z + a2 z 2 + . . . is said to belong to the class CV (R1 , R2 ) if it is univalent and convex in D, and if on f ({|z| = 1}) the curvature ρ satisfies the inequalities R1 ≤ ρ ≤ R2 . So far, little progress has been made on the study of this class of functions (see Goodman [340] and [341]); we do not even know the sharp bound for |a2 | in CV (R1 , R2 ). (A. W. Goodman)

evidence.quote: A function f (z) = z + a2 z 2 + . . . is said to belong to the class CV (R1 , R2 ) if it is univalent and convex in D, and if on f ({|z| = 1}) the curvature ρ satisfies the inequalities R1 ≤ ρ ≤ R2 .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$. For an analytic univalent function 
$$f(z)=z+a_2z^2+a_3z^3+\cdots$$
on $\mathbb{D}$ that maps $\mathbb{D}$ onto a convex domain, and for fixed positive constants $R_1\le R_2$, say that $f\in CV(R_1,R_2)$ provided the curvature $\rho$ of the image curve $f(\{|z|=1\})$ (interpreted as a boundary of the convex image) satisfies
$$R_1\le \rho\le R_2$$
at every (smooth) point of that boundary curve. Determine the sharp upper bound for $|a_2|$ over all $f\in CV(R_1,R_2)$, as an explicit function of $R_1$ and $R_2$, and exhibit the extremal functions.
artifact.category_tag: Univalent convex functions of bounded type
artifact.status_search_result: A web search surfaces Goodman's foundational papers on convex functions of bounded type CV(R₁,R₂) and related uniformly convex classes (UCV), where sharp bounds for |a₂| and |a₃| are known in the uniformly convex case. However, no source directly states a sharp bound for |a₂| over the original two-parameter class CV(R₁,R₂); the status of this specific problem could not be conclusively verified.

status_evidence.title: Convex functions of bounded type (Goodman)
status_evidence.snippet: A normalized univalent function is convex of bounded type if the curvature of the bounding curve lies between two fixed positive numbers; this class is denoted CV(R1,R2).
status_evidence.claim: Defines the class CV(R1,R2) and treats Koebe domain and a coefficient bound, but a sharp bound for |a2| is not stated.

status_evidence.title: Uniformly convex functions II
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp bounds on |a_n| for n=2,3 are obtained for the uniformly convex class UCV.
status_evidence.claim: Sharp coefficient bounds are available in the related UCV class but not specifically for CV(R1,R2).
